subject: Urgent: telemetry retention & exec brief for FastBank P0
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastbank.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: P0: sustained latency + error-rate spike; need logs & exec brief

Tessa —

We're seeing a sustained latency increase and a spike in 5xx errors on the Redwood endpoint serving FastBank's payment routing flow (route: /v1/generate/payment). Impact started ~2026-12-18T01:40Z and we've got customers seeing timeouts at the payment-confirm step. Throughput is about 2.5x of baseline which complicates the picture.

We need two things urgently: 1) a short packet of telemetry/log artifacts for our SOC & incident team (latency histograms, error-rate timeline, sample request/response traces) for 2026-12-18 01:30Z — 03:30Z in UTC; and 2) a one-page exec brief we can share with our CRO and ops leadership summarizing impact and mitigation steps.

We are on a call with legal at 11:00 ET and they asked for chain-of-custody notes for any exported artifacts (who accessed, where stored, how long retained). Can you confirm retention, redaction options, and whether we can produce sampled request bodies with PII masked?

Attached a sample error screenshot and an SRE note.

— Alex
Alex Chen
Technical Ops Lead, FastBank
alex.chen@fastbank.com

Attachments: slo_error_screenshot.png, fastbank_sre_note.txt
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastbank.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: P0: sustained latency + error-rate spike; need logs & exec brief

Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and the context. We're on this. Rafael (SRE) will assemble the telemetry window you requested and produce a short artifacts bundle; Kimberly (Security & Compliance) will scope the PII/redaction and chain-of-custody notes.

Quick asks while we collect: can you confirm the sampling rate you need for request bodies (full, 1:10, 1:100)? Also, do you want us to include KV-cache traces or only raw request/response logs?

Expect the first draft of the one-page exec brief within 2 hours. I'll also include a short checklist for evidence handling.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
CC: Jordan Blake (Account Lead)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastbank.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: P0: sustained latency + error-rate spike; need logs & exec brief

Alex / Tessa —

I've pulled the runtime telemetry for 2026-12-18 01:15Z — 03:45Z UTC from our primary shard and started an extraction job. Preliminary notes:
- 99th pct latency shifted from 180ms -> 1.2s during the peak.
- 5xx rate climbed from 0.02% -> 1.6% for the route.
- Throughput increased due to a replay loop caused by an upstream client retry pattern (we've identified several client IPs issuing high retry traffic).

I will produce: histograms (p50/p95/p99), per-minute 5xx timeseries CSV, and 10 sampled traces (1:100 sampling) with request IDs. For request/response bodies, Kimberly — please advise re: masking rules.

I'm packaging artifacts into: fastbank_sample_logs.tar.gz (contains logs/*.csv, traces/*.json, README.md). I'll place the bundle in a restricted S3 location and share a pre-signed link and audit entries. ETA: 45 minutes.

Rafael
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: fastbank_sample_logs.tar.gz (pending upload)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastbank.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: P0: sustained latency + error-rate spike; need logs & exec brief

Hi all —

Short answers so we can move fast:
- Masking: we can provide sampled request/response bodies with PII redacted using our standard redaction pipeline (hashing for account IDs, remove full PANs, mask email/SSNs). We will include a redaction manifest showing fields transformed.
- Chain-of-custody: we'll generate a simple audit.txt that lists extraction job id, S3 object(s), user principals who accessed, and timestamps. All actions will be logged in our audit trail (immutable event entries).
- Retention: for incident exports we default to 90 days unless a legal hold is requested; we can shorten to 30 days for FastBank if needed.

Alex — please confirm you want 1:100 sampling for bodies and that shortened retention to 30 days is acceptable. If legal asks for longer, we'll apply a legal hold and preserve per their instructions.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-18T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: P0: sustained latency + error-rate spike; need logs & exec brief

Thanks team —

1:100 sampling is fine for now. FastBank legal wants the command-line audit of the export (who ran the job) and the S3 pre-signed URL; 30-day retention is acceptable but put the bundle under a legal hold if we escalate. Also please include any routing/fallback decisions made by Redwood during the spike (were there fallbacks to model variants or region?).

We will review the exec brief at 12:00 ET and will ping if we need further escalation.

— Alex
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastbank.com>
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-19T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: P0: telemetry retention & exec brief for FastBank P0 — artifacts delivered

Alex —

Deliverables (attached / linked):
- fastbank_sample_logs.tar.gz (S3 pre-signed link: https://s3.redwood.ai/fastbank/exports/2026-12-18-01-15_03-45?sig=EXAMPLE) — contains CSV timeseries, 10 sampled traces (1:100), and a redaction_manifest.txt.
- exec_brief_draft.pdf (attached) — one-page summary of impact, timeline, mitigation steps, and recommended next steps for FastBank leadership.
- audit.txt — extraction job id: ex-job-9f2b, initiated by rafael.mendes@redwood.ai at 2026-12-18T10:16:23Z; S3 object: s3://redwood-exports/fastbank/ex-job-9f2b/fastbank_sample_logs.tar.gz; access log entries captured in internal Audit Service (ids: AUD-77819, AUD-77820).

Notes:
- During the peak, our smart routing did not trigger cross-region fallback because capacity in the assigned pool was not exhausted; we did perform an automatic downgrade to a quantized model variant for best-effort throughput on a subset of requests for ~4 minutes (01:58Z–02:02Z). We recorded those decisions in the mitigation.log inside the artifact bundle.
- We will retain the export for 30 days unless FastBank legal requests a hold; we will not delete until instructed.

Next steps: Rafael will send the pre-signed URL to your legal distribution and Kimberly will provide the redaction manifest and formal chain-of-custody note. Jordan, I'll work with you to finalize the exec brief language for your CRO.

Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: fastbank_sample_logs.tar.gz, exec_brief_draft.pdf, audit.txt
